"""Export only the three predeclared parameter blends; no native scoring."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
import mlx.core as mx
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('Scripts').resolve()))
from model_files import inventory
plan=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/boundary-blend-plan-2026-09-16.json').read_text())
old,new=map(Path,plan['parents'])
for parent,files in plan['parents'].items():
    for name,digest in files.items():assert hashlib.sha256((Path(parent)/'adapters'/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
assert inventory(old/'base')==inventory(new/'base')
configs=[json.loads((p/'adapters/adapter_config.json').read_text()) for p in [old,new]]
for name in ['fine_tune_type','num_layers','lora_parameters']:
    assert configs[0][name]==configs[1][name]
a,b=[mx.load(str(p/'adapters/adapters.safetensors')) for p in [old,new]]
assert set(a)==set(b) and len(a)==248
assert all(a[k].shape==b[k].shape and a[k].dtype==b[k].dtype==mx.float32 for k in a)
for alpha in plan['newAdapterWeights']:
    model=Path(f'Models/Artifacts/boundary-blend-{int(alpha*100):02d}')
    assert not model.exists()
    subprocess.run(['/bin/cp','-cR',str(old),str(model)],check=True)
    weights={k:a[k]*(1-alpha)+b[k]*alpha for k in a}
    mx.save_safetensors(str(model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors'),weights)
    print(str(model),hashlib.sha256((model/'adapters/adapters.safetensors').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)

plan.holdout: No release holdout query in this experiment.
plan.operation: Elementwise F32 interpolation of corresponding adapter tensors; unchanged four-bit base; no fusion. This is parameter interpolation, not an exact mixture of model outputs or weight deltas.
plan.purpose: Check whether the improved boundary validation behavior can retain the prior composition adapter behavior.
plan.selection: Include both measured endpoints. Require all adversarial/runtime checks. Maximize existing validation meaning preservation, then context fit, then exact plans; ties choose the lowest new-adapter weight. Record selection before one native development evaluation of a new winner. Reuse endpoint development evidence if an endpoint wins.
plan.status: Predeclared before boundary blend export or scoring.

"""Select one of three predeclared blends on validation, then score development once."""
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('Evals').resolve()))
import baseline
plan=json.loads(Path('Training/experiments/boundary-blend-plan-2026-09-16.json').read_text())
runner=Path('.build/out/Products/Debug/PoptartCleanupEval')
gold=Path('.build/recognition-validation-gold.jsonl')
adversarial=Path('Evals/fixtures/adversarial.jsonl')
parents=[json.loads(Path(name).read_text()) for name in ['Training/experiments/composition-adapter-2026-09-16.json','Training/experiments/boundary-2026-09-16.json']]
models={0:Path('Models/Artifacts/composition-qwen-adapter-v2'),1:Path('Models/Artifacts/boundary-qwen-step500')}
runs={0:parents[0]['validation'],1:parents[1]['validation'][str(parents[1]['selectedStep'])]}
for alpha in runs:
    assert runs[alpha]['report']['executionIdentity']==baseline.execution_identity(runner,models[alpha],gold,adversarial)
record=dict(plan=plan,status='Validation selection only; no promotion or release holdout query.',
            exportSource=Path('.context/prepare_boundary_blends.py').read_text(),probeSource=Path(__file__).read_text())
output=Path('Training/experiments/boundary-blends-2026-09-16.json')
def retain():output.write_text(json.dumps({**record,'validation':{str(k):v for k,v in runs.items()}},indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
def evaluate(label,model,extra):
    directory=Path('.build/'+label)
    with Path(str(directory)+'.log').open('w') as stream:
        subprocess.run(['.build/training-venv/bin/python','Evals/baseline.py','--runner',str(runner),
            '--model',str(model),'--output-directory',str(directory),*extra],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    return {**{n:json.loads((directory/(n+'.json')).read_text()) for n in ['report','evidence','failures']},
            'predictions':[json.loads(l) for l in (directory/'predictions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
            'nativeResources':(directory/'native-resources.txt').read_text()}
for alpha in plan['newAdapterWeights']:
    models[alpha]=Path(f'Models/Artifacts/boundary-blend-{int(alpha*100):02d}')
    runs[alpha]=evaluate(f'boundary-blend-{int(alpha*100):02d}-validation',models[alpha],['--gold',str(gold)])
    retain()
    print(alpha,runs[alpha]['report']['editPlanExact'],flush=True)
allowed=[]
for alpha,run in runs.items():
    report=run['report']
    for field,count in [('meaningPreservation',32),('contextFit',32),('editPlanExact',32),('adversarialSafe',11),('runtimeConsistency',43)]:
        assert report[field]['applicable']==count
    if all(report[field]['passed']==report[field]['applicable'] for field in ['adversarialSafe','runtimeConsistency']):allowed.append(alpha)
assert allowed
selected=max(allowed,key=lambda a:tuple(runs[a]['report'][k]['passed'] for k in ['meaningPreservation','contextFit','editPlanExact'])+(-a,))
record['selectedNewAdapterWeight']=selected
retain()
print('Selected before development:',selected,flush=True)
record['development']=parents[int(selected)]['development'] if selected in (0,1) else evaluate('boundary-blend-selected-development',models[selected],[])
retain()
print('development',record['development']['report']['editPlanExact'],flush=True)
